title: fix(types): object-master-detail-form, object-metric and pivot validate (objectui#10859, batch 2)
body:
Part of #10859
Clause-②: yes

Batch 2 of the family card: the three (i) keys batch 1 held for file reasons. Draft, head `6ee675b45d` (fix round 1, text only, on `72cf9d3123`); a dispatched dev's PR, so ready and landing are the seat's.

## What changed

- **`packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts`.** `PivotTableSchema`, a member for member mirror of the TypeScript `PivotTableSchema` (`packages/types/src/data-display.ts`): `rowField`, `columnField`, `valueField`, `data` required as declared; `aggregation` the five-value vocabulary; `drillDown` the shared `DrillDownConfigSchema`; `body` / `children` refused by name (the declaration's `?: never`, objectui#9256). `drillDown`'s `.describe` says the member is inert on a `pivot` node (fix round 1). `DataDisplaySchema` lists it. The `DrillDownConfigSchema` docblock sentence that named this pair unmirrored is amended.
- **`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`.** `ObjectMetricBlockSchema` and `ObjectMasterDetailFormBlockSchema`: `BaseSchema` + the `type` literal + `properties`, which IS the block's `@objectstack/spec` `ComponentPropsMap` row, by reference through `stripImportedDefaults` (the objectui#10872 convention). The master-detail arm also refuses `onSuccess`, `onError`, `onCancel` with `handlerKeyRefusal(…, 'runtime-slot')`. Both reach `AnyComponentSchema` through a new union, `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchema`.
- **`packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts`.** Four new barrel exports; `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchema` joins `AnyComponentSchema`'s arm list.
- **`packages/types/src/zod/README.md`.** Data Display gains `PivotTableSchema`; a new "ObjectQL Public Blocks (2)" group.
- **`packages/types/src/data-display.ts`.** One docblock sentence on `ObjectPivotDrillDownConfig` ("Neither `object-pivot` nor `PivotTableSchema` has a zod mirror") that this change made false. Comment only.
- **Pins:** `packages/types/src/__tests__/registered-type-arms-10859-b2.test.ts` (new) and the ratchet `packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts`.
- **Ledgers:** `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` — the `data-display.zod.ts#PivotTableSchema` pair (`EXPECTED_MIRROR_PAIRS` 169 to 170) and three `EXCLUSIONS` rows (the two spec-owned arms, the union); `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts` — the two rows' `IMPORTED` entries.
- **Changesets:** `.changeset/10859-pivot-object-block-zod-arms.md` (`'@object-ui/types': minor`, the `Clause-②: yes` line, no BREAKING banner: every document naming these types was refused at `type` before, at the root and at every child slot, so nothing that parsed is refused now). Dated notes, objectui#10533 form, frontmatter byte-identical, on `7352-drill-down-config-mirror.md` and `10685-drilldown-per-block.md`.

## H1 — the declaration of each key

| key | declaration | arm |
|---|---|---|
| `pivot` | `PivotTableSchema` in `packages/types/src/data-display.ts`, `type: 'pivot'` | hand mirror, member for member |
| `object-metric` | none on `@object-ui/types`. `@objectstack/spec/ui` (17.4.0): `ComponentPropsMap['object-metric']` = `ObjectMetricPropsSchema`, type `ObjectMetricProps`. objectui's other type, `ObjectMetricWidgetProps` (plugin-dashboard), is the widget's React props (a translator function, a React-node icon), not a document shape | `properties` = the row |
| `object-master-detail-form` | none on `@object-ui/types`. Spec: `ComponentPropsMap['object-master-detail-form']` = `ObjectMasterDetailFormPropsSchema`. `@object-ui/plugin-form` also exports `MasterDetailFormSchema`, the type of `MasterDetailForm`'s `schema` prop (the renderer's post-hoist reading): `type` optional, three host callbacks, no `BaseSchema` | `properties` = the row, + three runtime-slot refusals |

Both object-* keys have a published declaration (the spec row, which batch 1's (i) criterion counted), so neither is held. **Route change, declared:** the order's assumption was a TS-face interface mirrored with an `Equal` pin. For these two the declaration is a `ComponentPropsMap` row, and the house route for arming from a row is objectui#10872's `properties` by reference; the shipped documents (H3) are `properties`-form, which a flat restatement would refuse. Where `MasterDetailFormSchema` and the row disagree (it requires `objectName` and `details`; it types `title`, `submitText`, `cancelText` as `string` where the row takes `I18nLabel`), the spec is the contract. Their own union, not `ObjectQLComponentSchema`: that union mirrors the TS union in `objectql.ts` member for member, and `objectql-union-arms-7363.test.ts` pins its length.

## H2 — reproduced on `main` (`733fd5ac6`)

`safeValidateSchema`, on source:

```text
timeline (lit control): success=true
pivot: success=false :: invalid_union @ [type] Invalid input
object-metric: success=false :: invalid_union @ [type] Invalid input
object-master-detail-form: success=false :: invalid_union @ [type] Invalid input
```

At head all three are accepted; `objectui validate` (the CLI's `validate`, in-process) on the showcase master-detail document prints `✓ Schema is valid!` and `Type: object-master-detail-form`.

## H3 — taught and shipped documents

- `pivot`: no JSON document is taught or shipped. The registry tables in `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` name it only. `packages/plugin-dashboard/SKILL.md`'s `type: 'pivot'`, and the showcase chart-gallery dashboard's, are the dashboard WIDGET type, not this node.
- `object-metric`: the objectstack showcase ships it in `{ type, properties }` form (`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/index.ts`, four KPIs; `my-work.page.ts`, three) — accepted on both faces; the first `index.ts` KPI is pinned. `command-center.page.ts`'s `kpi()` node is accepted by the tolerant face; the strict face refuses its `responsiveStyles`, an envelope key `BaseSchema` does not declare on any arm. objectui teaches no JSON document (the `data-source.md` binding table, registry tables).
- `object-master-detail-form`: the showcase's `project-workspace.page.ts` form, `{ type, properties }` — accepted on both faces, pinned. `docs/adr/0001-master-detail-subform.md` and `apps/console/src/dev/DevMasterDetail.tsx` write it FLAT: the tolerant face accepts them (a flat key `BaseSchema` does not declare is unjudged) and the strict face refuses those keys by name, while a flat key `BaseSchema` does declare is judged by `BaseSchema`'s own type on both faces — the same boundary objectui#10872 left open for the public blocks.

## H4 — runtime readers

- `pivot` → `PivotTable` (registered as `pivot`): its destructure reads all 11 declared members (`title`, `rowField`, `columnField`, `valueField`, `aggregation`, `data`, `showRowTotals`, `showColumnTotals`, `format`, `columnColors`, `drillDown`).
- `object-metric` → `ObjectMetricBlock` → `ObjectMetricWidget`: its destructure reads all 18 row members; `objectName` and `filter` also arrive through the `dataSource` binding.
- `object-master-detail-form` → `MasterDetailFormRenderer` → `MasterDetailForm`: every one of the 14 row members is read off `schema`, and so are `onSuccess`, `onError`, `onCancel` (the runtime slots; `check:handler-key-reads` now judges them: `OK 131 arm(s) … 53 judged`).

No declared member without a reader, so nothing is narrowed. Two read-side observations are in Acceptance notes.

## Pins, red on base and green on head

Base = a detached worktree at `733fd5ac6` with the two pin files copied in; head = this branch. From the repo root: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/src/__tests__/registered-type-arms-10859-b2.test.ts packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts`.

| run | result |
|---|---|
| base, vitest | `Tests 30 failed / 9 passed (39)`: every new row red, the ratchet red (`refuses 76 registered bare key(s) at type; the pin is 73.`); green = the 9 pre-existing ratchet-file rows |
| base, `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` | exit 2: TS2305 / TS2724 (the four new exports missing) and TS2344 |
| head, vitest | `Tests 39 passed (39)` |
| head, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (all three programs) | exit 0; `--listFilesOnly` shows the pin in the test program |

Rows: each key's minimal document on `safeValidateSchema` and the strict face; the two showcase documents on both faces (each first parsed by the spec's own row); a full `pivot` document; a page of the three; an undeclared node key refused by name on the strict face per arm (tolerant passes it); an undeclared bag key refused on the TOLERANT face per spec-row arm; one spec-invalid value per arm (`aggregation: 'median'`, `properties.colorVariant: 'pink'`, `properties.formType: 'wizzard'`, each `invalid_value` at that path); `pivot`'s required `data`; `drillDown` judged by the shared mirror; both content channels; the three runtime slots; the bag's key set equal to the row's and answering four probes as the row does. Type level: `pivot`'s key set and member types invariantly equal to the declaration's; each bag's input type equal to the spec's `ObjectMetricProps` / `ObjectMasterDetailFormProps`; an instrument-fires row.

**Type-level reverse validation** (objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, WRAP mode, anchor x1 to x0, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty): `PivotTableSchema.format` retyped to `z.number()` → `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 2, TS2344 on the member-types row plus the mirror-parity ledgers naming `data-display.zod.ts#PivotTableSchema` and `format`; the `object-metric` bag restated as a one-member strict object → exit 2, TS2344 on the bag row.

**Ablation.** `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchema` dropped from `AnyComponentSchema`'s list and `PivotTableSchema` from `DataDisplaySchema`'s, two nested WRAP invocations inside a script with its own EXIT/INT/TERM trap: anchors x1 to x0, blobs `bdd57555a921` to `a431c90b3df6` and `bbeac45eafb5` to `1a2f01f85196`, both restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty. Result `Tests 28 failed / 11 passed (39)`. Observed direction: the order predicted that only the acceptance rows and the ratchet redden; every refusal row reddens too, because with no arm those documents are refused at `type` instead of by name (batch 1 observed the same). Green: the two rows that read the arms directly and the 9 pre-existing ratchet rows. Vitest aliases `@object-ui/types/zod` to `src/`, so no build sits between mutation and reading.

## The sweep

`git grep` over every tracked test file for `AnyComponentSchema`, `StrictAnyComponentSchema`, `safeValidateSchema`, `nodeOracles`, `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES`, `propsLevelOf`, `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, `unmirroredAlias`, `collectArms`, `getPublicConfigs`, `ComponentPropsMap`, `check-handler-key-read-sites`, `block-config-schema-parity-8216`, `registry-inputs-spec-parity`, `strict-authoring-face-8345`, `zod-mirror-parity`: 229 files (the order's nine terms alone: 132, all inside the 229). Plus the handler-key census readers outside `packages/types` (`detail-handler-slots-7804`, `detail-view-handler-slots-9447`, `handlerKeyDispositionsMeasured-7804`, `kanban-handler-slots-7664`, the two `7077` button-group files) and `markdown-test-inputs.test.ts`.

- `packages/types/` and `packages/cli/` whole, at `72cf9d3123`, with the changeset-reading script suites: `Test Files 294 passed (294)`, `Tests 6549 passed (6549)`.
- The other 113 files: `Test Files 113 passed (113)`, `Tests 1945 passed (1945)` — among them `block-config-schema-parity-8216` (its node oracle now judges `object-metric`'s designer fields at `properties`), `registry-inputs-spec-parity`, `public-contract`, `check-handler-key-read-sites`.

## Gates

Under the verify lock where they build or test. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli type-check` exit 0 after `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/cli^...' build`.

exit 0: `check-changeset-presence` (`9 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`), `pnpm changeset:check`, `check-changeset-overwrite` (report-only; the two dated notes), `check:changeset-claims` (report-only; 46 pending changesets name a file touched here, read below), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `census:changeset-polarity`, `check:handler-key-reads` (`OK 131 arm(s)`), `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:doc-types`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:self-import`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit` (`105 candidate test files, all adjudicated`).

eslint, a proven narrowing: the eight changed `.ts` files, `--no-inline-config --format json` → 8 files, 0 errors, 33 warnings; the same seven pre-existing files at `733fd5ac6` carry the same 33 (all `no-explicit-any`), the new file 0. Population: `@object-ui/types` lints `.`, `@object-ui/cli` lints `src`; `eslint.config.js` sets no `projectService` / `parserOptions`, so no rule can move an untouched file's verdict. The full `pnpm lint` is CI's.

NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports` (PREREQUISITE NOT MET — unbuilt packages, population floor), `check:sdui-registration-pins` (no console build), `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples` (full package build). No README code fence changed; CI measures them.

## Serial

objectui#10908 (objectui#10872 batch 2) shares `index.zod.ts`, `zod/README.md`, the ratchet file, `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` and `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts` with this branch; every hunk here sits outside its hunks (the ratchet change is the `REFUSED_AT_TYPE` line, not the `NAMESPACED_` one). `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head `72cf9d3123` against its head `fe8f6a6aad`: exit 0. Against a fresh `origin/main` `733fd5ac65`: exit 0. `objectql.zod.ts`, `data-display.zod.ts` and `data-display.ts` are held by no open PR (the claim's reading).

## Fix round 1 (contract review FAIL, text only)

One commit, `6ee675b45d`, no behaviour change:

1. The changeset's flat-key sentence now separates a key `BaseSchema` does not declare (unjudged on the tolerant face, refused by name on the strict face) from one it does (`label`, `description`: judged by `BaseSchema`'s own type on both faces).
2. `PivotTableSchema.drillDown`'s `.describe` no longer promises a drill: it names the member inert on a `pivot` node and points at `object-pivot`. No test quoted the old string.
3. The `ObjectMasterDetailFormBlockSchema` docblock and its `EXCLUSIONS` reason call `MasterDetailFormSchema` the type of `MasterDetailForm`'s `schema` prop (the renderer's post-hoist reading), and "all four keys" became "both keys".
4. The `7352` dated note names the second "Unchanged" bullet and the opening paragraph's count (two referencing declarations, three for the release). Frontmatter byte-identical; the note is this PR's own and was only amended.

At `6ee675b45d`, under the verify lock: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` + the ratchet + six changeset / markdown script suites → `Test Files 272 passed (272)`, `Tests 6168 passed (6168)`; the b2 pin, `zod-mirror-parity`, `drill-down-config-mirror-7352`, `content-channel-family-d-9256` and the ratchet named → `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 864 passed (864)`; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` exit 0. exit 0: `check:changeset-claims` (report-only), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`). `git merge-tree --write-tree` of `6ee675b45d` against a fresh `origin/main` `733fd5ac65`: exit 0; against objectui#10908's head `fe8f6a6aad`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **The ratchet:** `REFUSED_AT_TYPE` 76 to **73**. `NAMESPACED_REFUSED_AT_TYPE` untouched (398 on `main`).
- **Still held:** the designer six (ruling 5861220023's settlement), the 28 (ii) keys (the maintainer's criterion), the 30 proposed (iii) and 9 unclear keys (the seat's ruling).
- **Pending changesets read:** the 46 `check:changeset-claims` names, grepped for claims about these keys, arm counts and category modules. Dated notes where a sentence became false: `7352-drill-down-config-mirror.md` ("`PivotTableSchema.drillDown` has no zod mirror at all") and `10685-drilldown-per-block.md` ("neither `object-pivot` nor `PivotTableSchema` has a zod mirror"). Read and left: `8344` (no new category module), `8499` and `7363` (their counts are their own change's reading), `9024` (`PivotTableSchema` still declares no `filter`).
- **Observations** (per ruling 5861341151 each unhonoured member rides this arm only with a filed carrier; the seat filed objectui#10932 for the first and objectui#10935 for the second):
  - `pivot`'s `drillDown` makes cells interactive only when a host passes `onDrillDown`; only `ObjectPivotTable` does, so on the registry path (`DashboardGridLayout`'s static-data pivot, an authored `pivot` node) it is inert.
  - the spec row types `object-master-detail-form`'s `title`, `submitText`, `cancelText` as `I18nLabel`; `MasterDetailForm` renders `submitText` and `cancelText` as React children and interpolates `title` into a toast, so a locale map there is not resolved.
  - the strict face refuses the spec envelope key `responsiveStyles` on every arm (`BaseSchema` does not declare it); the strict face has no CLI door.
- **The flat spelling** of `object-metric` / `object-master-detail-form` (ADR-0001, the dev harness, plugin-form's own composed nodes) is not judged against the spec row: a flat key `BaseSchema` does not declare is unjudged on the tolerant face and refused by name on the strict face, while one it does declare (`label`, `description`) is judged by `BaseSchema`'s type. Route A, confirmed by the contract review; the flat channel stays the question objectui#10872 left open for the whole public-block family (the seat's note on objectui#10872 names these two arms for that batch), and declaring it later is additive.
- **Label:** `needs:contract-review` was applied by the seat after the dev report.
